from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class PrivateLotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](201)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                close = float(data.Bars[symbol].Close)

                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_closes.Add(close)

                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    self.aapl_closes.Add(close)

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (self.spy_closes.Count < 201 or
                self.aapl_closes.Count < 4 or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = self.spy_closes[0]
        spy_previous_close = self.spy_closes[1]

        spy_sma_200 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(200)) / 200.0
        spy_previous_sma_200 = (
            sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 201)) / 200.0
        )

        spy_sma_50 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(50)) / 50.0
        spy_previous_sma_50 = (
            sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 51)) / 50.0
        )

        aapl_close = self.aapl_closes[0]
        aapl_red_three_days = (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
            self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
            self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if (self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and
                spy_previous_close >= spy_previous_sma_50 and
                spy_close < spy_sma_50):
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if (self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and
                spy_previous_close <= spy_previous_sma_200 and
                spy_close > spy_sma_200):
            quantity = int(math.floor(
                (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            ))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / aapl_close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.sma(self.spy, 200, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.sma(self.spy, 50, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.rsi(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY
        )

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        complete_day = all(
            data.bars.contains_key(symbol) and data.bars[symbol] is not None
            for symbol in self.symbols
        )

        if complete_day:
            spy_close = data.bars[self.spy].close
            aapl_close = data.bars[self.aapl].close

            ready = (
                self.spy_sma_200.is_ready
                and self.spy_sma_50.is_ready
                and self.aapl_rsi_14.is_ready
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            )

            if ready:
                sma_200_crosses_above = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma_200.current.value
                )
                sma_50_crosses_below_sma_200 = (
                    self.previous_spy_sma_50 >= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                    and self.spy_sma_50.current.value < self.spy_sma_200.current.value
                )

                # Sells are evaluated before buys.
                if (
                    self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                    and sma_50_crosses_below_sma_200
                ):
                    self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = 0

                if (
                    self.strategy_b_shares > 0
                    and self.aapl_rsi_14.current.value > 60
                ):
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = 0

                if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and sma_200_crosses_above:
                    quantity = int(
                        math.floor(
                            (self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) / spy_close
                        )
                    )
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

                if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                    if self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
                        quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / aapl_close))
                        if quantity > 0:
                            self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                            self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.current.value
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.current.value

        if data.bars.contains_key(self.aapl) and data.bars[self.aapl] is not None:
            aapl_close = data.bars[self.aapl].close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

class PrivateLotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](200)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](15)

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.a_lot = 0
        self.b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_closes.Add(spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_bar.Close)

        self.spy_sma_200.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
        self.spy_sma_50.Update(self.Time, spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(self.Time, aapl_bar.Close)

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.a_lot > 0 and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady and self.spy_closes.Count >= 2:
            yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
            yesterday_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Window[1].Value if self.spy_sma_50.Window.Count >= 2 else None
            today_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

            if yesterday_sma_50 is not None and yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma_50 and today_close < today_sma_50:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.a_lot)
                self.a_lot = 0

        if self.b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.b_lot)
            self.b_lot = 0

        if self.a_lot == 0 and self.spy_sma_200.IsReady and self.spy_closes.Count >= 2:

            yesterday_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Window[1].Value if self.spy_sma_200.Window.Count >= 2 else None

            if yesterday_sma_200 is not None and yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma_200 and today_close > today_sma_200:
                quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) // today_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.a_lot = quantity

        if self.b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_closes.Count >= 4 and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady:
            if (self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
                    self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and

                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.Close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.b_lot = quantity
